articles.classification: behaviour change: Analysis now extracts Key dates (DECISIONS-CONTRACTS AI Key date extraction, 2026-09-15). This is not a copy-only correction; the V-C21 walkthrough must be rerun.

corrections.section: Run Analysis and read its outcome

corrections.after: Analysis also extracts named milestones with explicit dates. Result rows are labelled Key date. A written milestone is added to Key dates with an Unverified marker; a duplicate of an existing Key date or term date is Kept and adds no row.

corrections.section: Run Analysis and read its outcome
corrections.before: Check the saved value on Overview or Fields.
corrections.after: Check the saved value on Overview, Fields or Key dates.

corrections.before: Correction happens only through Overview or Fields controls.
corrections.after: An extracted Key date is corrected with Edit date or Remove date in Key dates. A date or event change, or removal, clears the marker and later runs do not add it again. A note-only or reminder-only change does not clear the marker.
corrections.source: apps/api/src/modules/contract-key-dates/routes.ts (reviewKeyDate on date/label change and delete); apps/api/src/lib/ai-unverified.ts reviewKeyDate; DECISIONS-CONTRACTS AI Key date extraction

corrections.after: If the card is absent, the connector is disabled, no values are marked, and the Contract has no Analysis run.

confirmedClaims: Run analysis, Confirm and Confirm all are Administrator and Legal Team Member actions (requireMember); Business Users cannot run or confirm.
Run requires an enabled AI connector, a Contract that is neither Ended nor archived, a primary Document, and ready non-empty target text; refusal messages match.
Target is the primary Document's executed pin, else its highest Version; a newer upload does not displace the pin.
Automatic runs start when target text becomes ready or the target Version is pinned; the AI analysis card sits below the Fields card and the Contract actions menu offers Run analysis.

Card sentences: Running…, Completed {when} on Version {version} with {model}., Failed {when} on Version {version} with {model}: {reason}, and the Request-context pending, failed and completed sentences.
Outcome labels Written, Kept, Unsupported, Invalid, Unmatched; Counterparty links only one matching live Counterparty when none is linked.
Confirmation clears only the named marker and records contract.field_confirmed; an archived Contract refuses confirmation; an Ended, non-archived Contract still allows Confirm and edits.
Human writes, confirmations and explicit clears are kept in analysisHumanFields and are not overwritten; a flagged value can be replaced; Value amount, currency and cadence are written together.
Evidence sparkle opens the cited Version in the doc panel from the saved run outcome; unavailable evidence shows the unavailable message.
Fill Contract Fields after conversion is a separate switch; Retry Request-context Analysis shows only for a failed conversion run; restricted and Confidential sources are excluded.
Contract actions menu, Fields and Key dates tab labels match messages/en-US.json.

articles.classification: permission change: Contributor accounts were removed (DD-023) and the Document reader guard is now Administrator and Legal Team Member only. The earlier V-C29 contributor role row no longer applies; the walkthrough must be rerun for both roles.

corrections.before: The Document reader offers Compare when a previous eligible Version exists.
corrections.after: Also: when a ready Comparison exists for that pair, the link shows its change count instead of Compare.

corrections.before: Comparisons and Generated redline exports remain staff actions.
corrections.after: Only Administrators and Legal Team Members can open Comparisons and export Generated redlines.
corrections.source: CONTEXT.md lists staff as an avoided term; document-access.ts requireDocumentReader and document-compare.tsx loader are Member+

confirmedClaims: Compare with previous is in the Document and Version actions menus when a previous non-redline Version exists, including on frozen records.
Pair control reads v{from} → v{to} with Older and Newer selects that exclude Generated redlines and navigate at once.
Two Word operands use word mode; other pairs use text mode; a Version with no extractable text fails with a reason; failed text extraction fails the Comparison.
Preparing comparison, Changes, Previous change, Next change, No changes, Close comparison and the extracted-text notice match source.
A stored pair is reused (200) and is readable on archived Documents; a failed pair has no retry and offers Download links.

Export track changes needs a ready Word Comparison and an open Document and owner; it appends a generated_redline Version that names both operands, and the same pair returns the existing Version; Open redline then appears.
Text Comparisons show Export needs two Word files. to Administrators and Legal Team Members on a non-archived Document.

limitations: Source inspection only. No walkthrough was run by this agent; an independent agent runs V-C21 and V-C29.
